items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: I just wondered if you knew what had happened to him.

ctx.x: Then Charlie Skeet, we got rid of him and got Claude Hopkins in the band.

That's how that started, Claude Hopkins band. That's how that started and went to the Savoy Ballroom, pretty good band. So when they hired us in the Savoy Ballroom, Chick Webb Band was at the Savoy, so they went down to the Roseland Mall. So happened to the manager, happened to come in to Savoy and he said you'd rather have Claude Hopkins band than Chick Webb Band. That's how we got into the Roseland Mall. We Claude Hopkins band. Do you know Geechee Fields? Traumhole player? Traumhole player. Yeah, I don't know…
No. I heard he's still around New York, I think it was three or four years.
